title: Qualify Duo simulator evidence boundaries
admission: User requests a bounded simulator-to-device assessment and execution of all simulator-capable existing release gates. No new product surface or gate.
environment: Xcode27.1/27A9269, iOS27.1/24A94401 iPhone Duo simulator. No physical Duo comparison available.
protocol: Verify actual CLI and MCP SDK27.1, preserve user simulator and protected files, use a freshly resolved idle Duo and restore its original state.
Revalidate the retained EXP-191 source manifest and all three Mach-O hashes; use fresh native run IDs, clean installation and complete local artifacts.

Qualify actual outer/inner display transitions, rotation and partial fold via Device Hub; record device display state and app scene/trait/geometry observations rather than inferring from pose controls.
Run unchanged EXP-191 first. Require simultaneous native scene activation/geometry before and through each critical ownership boundary. Preserve an inconclusive attempt before any harness repair.

Exercise genuine OS focus/background/foreground, close/disconnect/reconnect and recognized interactive gestures only where the simulator and existing harness can express them. No posted-notification substitutes.
For each capability retain strict native semantic and backend owners where applicable, negative controls, exact evidence boundary and hardware residual. Stop after two equivalent platform failures.

Complete the finite H01-H16 simulator routing table; reuse accepted telemetry and compatibility evidence. Measure confidence qualitatively per capability, never as an uncalibrated physical-equivalence percentage.

decisive_tests.oracle: Outer/inner/rotated/partially folded state changes produce measured scene bounds and traits; distinguish layout containers from native scene identity.
Two different native scene sessions are simultaneously visible before/during H01 critical steps; distinct RUM owners and fresh occurrences satisfy the unchanged oracle.
Actual OS activation/background/foreground preserves peer ownership and records callback order without fabricated notifications.
Actual close/disconnect/remount has one stop, fresh replacement ownership, no stale adoption, and uninterrupted peer ownership.
Actual recognizer begins/cancels/completes; cancelled transitions preserve occurrence and completion creates the expected fresh destination. Button navigation is not gesture proof.
Separate source equivalence, observed simulator behavior, unexecuted capabilities and physical residuals; exact owner/occurrence/topology controls remain decisive.

closure_rule: Complete this assessment only when each Q1-Q6 cell has an observed result or concrete executable limitation and the finite H01-H16 simulator routing is recorded. Physical F04/F05 and existing human/device obligations are not waived.

explicit_differences: DeviceInfo simulator model/host process CPU and RAM
source_audit.scope: Conditional-compilation search over first-party Core/Internal/RUM/Trace/Logs/SessionReplay/CrashReporting/Profiling sources; not proof of UIKit/SwiftUI or third-party runtime equivalence.

bounded_harness_amendment: Calibrate real timed gestures using an XCTest UI target, with before/after accessibility and screenshots. Require observed paired native windows before resuming H01; add live topology admission at and throughout its mutation interval, with serial/overlap/identity negative controls. Do not alter production SDK or weaken the original 22 semantic assertions.

steps: Fresh clean installation and manifest; native ready inner regular width with no selected detail.
Close/open Duo: capture active display ID, geometry, traits and native path at each boundary; no Detail owner may appear while selection is nil.
Use documented native appResize to measure regular -> compact -> regular with actual readback if supported; preserve this as synthetic resize, separate from physical pose.

Select Detail1 through delivered native UI, then repeat acknowledged width transitions. Require retained selection/path and exact Detail owner if no native background occurred; otherwise preserve the different lifecycle boundary explicitly.
Export complete native sequence and query exact run/session backend views, markers/resources and errors before cleanup.
h14_protocol.acceptance: No stale source/run, no fabricated scene callbacks, no late-only geometry assertion, no unexpected Detail during nil selection, no duplicate or foreign owner at selected boundaries; hardware H14 residual remains.

next: EXP-193 qualifies H14 with the current accepted-state host; equivalent XCTest inner-display pairing attempts are stopped after two. Q5 outer-display gesture input remains dependency-ready.

adaptive_followup.current_state: EXP-193 resize slice passes5 phases,16 exact native/backend work,3-view inventory,0 errors and1/1 guarded XCTest prefix. Both task bundles/data and resize process are cleaned; pose10-phase run still awaits unlock.
adaptive_followup.observed_limit: Resizable display remains black despite native geometry; ending headless resize backgrounds the scene. Preserve callback ownership and visible-layout/input claims separately.

q5_outer_protocol_defined_before_impleme.admission: Complete Q5 input qualification and existing H11-H13 simulator routing; no new release gate. Desktop pose controls remain blocked but task-only reboot may expose the outer display; require actual readback.
q5_outer_protocol_defined_before_impleme.first_slice: UIKit native edge-pop control with automatic pops disabled, on an observed compact outer display. Two fresh runs cover a short slow drag with held endpoint (cancel candidate) and a long edge drag (completion candidate).
q5_outer_protocol_defined_before_impleme.observer: Passive UINavigationController transition-coordinator observation, only for native gesture scenarios; require isInteractive and observed completion isCancelled. No percent-driven/programmatic transition substitution.
q5_outer_protocol_defined_before_impleme.oracle: Before input, native compact geometry and active secondary-2 owner. Genuine began/resolved pair after the command; cancel retains exact secondary-2 ID and creates no secondary-1 occurrence, finish reveals one fresh secondary-1 before callback Action/Resource. Exact backend owners and errors remain decisive.
q5_outer_protocol_defined_before_impleme.automation: Fresh XCTest run ID, per-command host admission, captured window/touch coordinates and native JSONL; release cleanup only after export. Tool return or XCTest pass alone never proves recognized gesture.
q5_outer_protocol_defined_before_impleme.stop_rule: At most two equivalent input failures. Record concrete limitations and retain physical/human gates. If recognized input works, continue the remaining SwiftUI/presentation simulator slices under their unchanged semantic contracts.
